beginner.summary: For Kubernetes users, DevOps engineers and developers who deploy with kubectl or Helm today and want to adopt GitOps with Argo CD. Covers the Argo CD components and reconciliation model, installation on a local cluster, the argocd CLI and web UI, the Application resource, sync and health status, manual and automated sync with prune and self-heal, sync options, private repository credentials, plain YAML, Helm and Kustomize sources, sync waves and resource hooks, health assessment, diff customization, local users and the default project, and diagnosing OutOfSync applications, ending with a capstone that delivers a three-tier app entirely from Git.
prerequisites: Deploys and inspects workloads with kubectl: Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets and namespaces
Uses Git from the command line: clone, branch, commit, push and pull requests on GitHub or GitLab
Has a laptop with Docker or Podman, kind or minikube, kubectl and rights to install the argocd CLI
outcomes: Install Argo CD on a Kubernetes cluster and operate it through the argocd CLI, the web UI and kubectl
Write Application manifests that deploy plain YAML, Helm charts and Kustomize overlays from Git
Control how changes reach the cluster with manual and automated sync, prune, self-heal, sync options, waves and hooks
Read sync and health status, customise diffs and diagnose OutOfSync, Degraded and ComparisonError applications
